messages:
lina_cs: Heads-up: SolsticeHealth hit multiple budget alerts overnight. AM wants a short cost-risk brief for their QBR next Monday. Can we triage and propose 1-2 actionable mitigations?
diego_eng: Looking now. Preliminary telemetry points to repeated full-context embeddings from their analytics pipeline. Sample log:```path=/v1/embeddings model=embed-large tokens_out=1,024,567 requests=1,230``` That route dominates.
mika_solutions: We should teach them batching + per-doc chunking. I can prep a 20-min playbook and a short checklist they can hand to infra.
lina_cs: Great. Henry, any renewal pressure we should model into asks?
henry_revops: Renewal conversation scheduled day after QBR. We should avoid surprise over-commit asks. Propose two scenarios: (A) short-term mitigation + month-to-month cushion; (B) 6mo commit at a discounted rate if they accept enablement/ops changes.
diego_eng: Quick config to test on canary:```embedding_truncate_chars: 2000
chunk_size_tokens: 512
enable_batching: true
batch_timeout_ms: 25``` Expect ~30% token reduction on that pipeline in sim. I'll run a 48h sim and post results.
cost-bot: [automated] budget-alert:solstice.health triggered 2026-04-02T02:14:09Z limit=1,000,000 tokens/day observed=1,375,432
mika_solutions: I'll record two tiny demos: (1) chunking code snippet + expected cost delta (2) how to instrument prefix caching. Will share links.
henry_revops: For the forecast slide: please include current monthly run-rate, projected post-mitigation run-rate (conservative/optimistic), and recommended commit tier with pricing delta. I'll draft suggested language for AM.
lina_cs: Action items: diego -> canary sim + per-route delta by EOD tomorrow; mika -> draft playbook + short demo links by tomorrow; henry -> slide copy + renewal ask draft by Thu.
diego_eng: A couple Qs: do we have permission to use a sanitized sample of their requests for the sim?
lina_cs: Yes, approved under current onboarding NDA. Use redacted ids; avoid PHI. Share via secure link.
mika_solutions: Noted on PHI. I'll craft examples based on synthetic data.
henry_revops: I'll prepare two pricing lines: baseline monthly, and 6mo commit with 18% discount.
lina_cs: Thanks all. If the canary confirms 30% savings we can push the commit ask confidently and include an enablement milestone in the contract. :rocket:
